title: maybe okay for the money - UPDATE
text:
maybe okay for the money - UPDATE. Material is a little thinner than foodsavers but acceptable - I have had only two failures, one on trying to seal initially which may have been my fault cutting too close and another in the freezer. But otherwise good.

UPDATE- I have now found another bag in the freezer where seal has failed. Sausages - nothing sharp in there and nothing was cut close to seam. I feel you just have to take your chances with these and keep an eye on the food in the freezer. There are some generics I have found as good as foodsavers for a little less money. You need to experiment and frequently what you like you can't find again. So ongoing.

product_metadata.title: Keep Fresh Food Vacuum Sealer Rolls (15" x 50', 2 Rolls), 3.5mil Food Storage Bags for Sous Vide and Freezer Storage (100 Feet)
features: 2-PACK OF VACUUM SEALER ROLLS. Vacuum bags can be cut and sealed at both ends to create your own custom sized vacuum storage bag. Vacuum bags become airtight to prevent freezer burn and save food from being wasted.

WORKS WITH ALL VACUUM SEALER MACHINES. Keep Fresh vacuum seal bags are compatible with all vacuum sealer brands. These clear vacuum sealer bags have texture on one side and smooth on the other which allows them to work great with any type of vacuum sealer.

STRONG BAGS THAT SEAL WELL. Heavy duty, high quality commercial grade vacuum bags made of a 7-layer construction to keep more air out, be more puncture resistant, and hold a vacuum seal longer than any other plastic vacuum bag.
KEEPS ITEMS FRESH. A vacuum seal bag can be stored in the freezer, put into the microwave to heat food, washed in the dishwasher, boiled in a pot of water, or resealed to be used again.

BPA FREE MATERIAL - Keep Fresh Bags uses BPA-free material that is safe to store food in. Once sealed, these bags are safe for microwaving, boiling, and freezing. They are great for preventing freezer burn on various frozen foods. A single side of the food storage bags is equipped with cross venting channels to maximize air extraction. You can reuse the bags after opening to make the roll last even longer. Simply put the food back in the bag and reseal.
